entries.title: Acts 19:1
segments: And it happened in the [time] Apollos was at Corinth, Paul [was] passing through the higher parts to Ephesus. And finding certain disciples,

entries.title: Acts 19:2
segments: he said to them, Have you received [the] Holy Spirit since you believed? And they said to him, We did not so much as hear whether [the] Holy Spirit is.

entries.title: Acts 19:3
segments: And he said to them, Then to what were you baptized? And they said, To John's baptism.

entries.title: Acts 19:4
segments: And Paul said, John truly baptized [with] the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe into Him coming after him, that is, into Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 19:5
segments: And hearing, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 19:6
segments: And as Paul laid [his] hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke with tongues and prophesied.

entries.title: Acts 19:7
segments: And all of the men were about twelve.

entries.title: Acts 19:8
segments: And going into the synagogue, he spoke boldly for three months, reasoning and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Acts 19:9
segments: But when some were hardened and did not believe, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

entries.title: Acts 19:10
segments: And this happened over two years, so that all those living in Asia heard the Word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

entries.title: Acts 19:11
segments: And God did works of power through the hands of Paul,

entries.title: Acts 19:12
segments: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons from his skin being brought onto the sick, the diseases were released, and the evil spirits went out of them.

entries.title: Acts 19:13
segments: And certain from the strolling Jews, exorcists, undertook to name the name of the Lord Jesus over those having evil spirits, saying, We adjure you [by] Jesus whom Paul preaches.

entries.title: Acts 19:14
segments: And there were seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did so.

entries.title: Acts 19:15
segments: But answering the evil spirit said, Jesus I know, and I comprehend Paul, but who are you?

entries.title: Acts 19:16
segments: And the man in whom the evil spirit resided leaped on them, and overcoming them he was strong against them, so that they fled out of the house naked and wounded.

entries.title: Acts 19:17
segments: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks who lived at Ephesus, and fear fell on all of them, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

entries.title: Acts 19:18
segments: And many who believed came and confessed and showed their deeds.

entries.title: Acts 19:19
segments: Also many of those practicing the curious arts, bringing together the books, burned [them] before all. And they counted the prices of them and found [it to be] fifty thousand [pieces] of silver.

entries.title: Acts 19:20
segments: So the Word of God grew mightily and prevailed.

entries.title: Acts 19:21
segments: After these things were ended, passing through Macedonia and Achaia, Paul purposed in the spirit to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have come there, I must also see Rome.

entries.title: Acts 19:22
segments: And sending into Macedonia two who ministered to him, Timothy and Erastus, he stayed in Asia for a time.

entries.title: Acts 19:23
segments: And about that time there was no little a stir about the Way.

entries.title: Acts 19:24
segments: For a certain silversmith named Demetrius was making silver temples of Artemis, providing not a little trade [for] the craftsmen.

entries.title: Acts 19:25
segments: And assembling the workmen about such things, he said, Men, you know that from this trade is our wealth.

entries.title: Acts 19:26
segments: And you see and hear that, not only at Ephesus, but almost all Asia, this Paul having persuaded, he has perverted a huge crowd, saying that those which are made with hands are no gods.

entries.title: Acts 19:27
segments: And not only is this dangerous to us, our share coming into dispute, but also the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted for nothing, and her magnificence is also about to be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.

entries.title: Acts 19:28
segments: And hearing, and becoming full of anger, they cried out, saying, Great [is] Artemis of [the] Ephesians.

entries.title: Acts 19:29
segments: And all the city was filled with confusion. And they rushed with one accord to the theater, keeping a firm grip on Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, traveling companions of Paul.

entries.title: Acts 19:30
segments: And Paul intending to go in to the mob, the disciples did not allow him.

entries.title: Acts 19:31
segments: And some of the chief men of Asia, being his friends, sent to him, begging [him] not to give himself into the theater.

entries.title: Acts 19:32
segments: Then indeed others cried out, some other things; for the assembly was confused, and most of them did not know why they had come together.

entries.title: Acts 19:33
segments: And they dragged Alexander forward out of the crowd, the Jews thrusting him forward. And waving [his] hand Alexander desired to defend himself to the mob.

entries.title: Acts 19:34
segments: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice cried out for two hours' [time], Great [is] Artemis of [the] Ephesians!

entries.title: Acts 19:35
segments: And quieting the crowd, the town clerk said, Men, Ephesians! What one of you does not know that the city of the Ephesians is a worshiper of the great goddess Artemis, and of That Fallen from the Sky?

entries.title: Acts 19:36
segments: Since these things cannot be spoken against, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rashly.

entries.title: Acts 19:37
segments: For you have brought these men, who are neither robbers of churches nor blasphemers of your goddess.

entries.title: Acts 19:38
segments: Therefore if Demetrius and those craftsmen with him truly have a matter against anyone, the court days are [kept], and there are proconsuls. Let them plead against one another.

entries.title: Acts 19:39
segments: But if you ask anything concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

entries.title: Acts 19:40
segments: For we are in danger to be accused of revolt concerning today; there being no cause by which we may give an account of this crowding together.

entries.title: Acts 19:41
segments: And saying these things, he dismissed the assembly.
